description:
v1.0 | 25 gates | 3 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Counts pulses, 0 to 255 and around again.

A counter keeps a running total of how many times something has happened, such as laps on a track or items passing a sensor.

The count input adds one each time it is pulsed, and the reset input sets the count back to zero. The outputs show the count. Both inputs must be on for exactly one tick, and not in the same tick. A button or switch is too slow, so send it through a one-tick pulse maker first. Holding an input on for longer than one tick gives a wrong count. The count starts at zero.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): count = x 0, reset = x 1 (pulses of exactly one tick).
Outputs (green gates): the count = x 0-7.

Profile: small, the build with the fewest gates for this size.
How it works: Each bit is an XOR gate wired to itself; a pulse flips the bits that must change.
Ticks from an input to the outputs: 0. From a pulse to the outputs: 3. Inputs steady before a pulse: 1.
Checked with thousands of random operations in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.
By: byggmesterPRO
